title: Māradhammasuttaṃ
text: 171 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘‘māradhammo, māradhammo’ti, bhante, vuccati. Katamo nu kho, bhante, māradhammo’’ti? ‘‘Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, māradhammo, vedanā māradhammo, saññā māradhammo, saṅkhārā māradhammo, viññāṇaṃ māradhammo. Evaṃ passaṃ…pe… nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī’’ti. Dutiyaṃ.
